items.title: Keenan Allen: Shipped to San Francisco
items.text:
The 49ers acquired Allen from the Colts on Tuesday in exchange for a 2027 sixth-round pick, Tom Pelissero of Netflix reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.text:

items.title: Kaleb Johnson: Could lead backfield again Week 10
items.text:
Johnson could serve as the Packers' lead option on the ground in Sunday's game against the Vikings with Josh Jacobs (finger) expected to miss multiple weeks and with the status of MarShawn Lloyd (knee) uncertain, Matt Schneidman of The Athletic reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Mike Evans: Not trending toward Week 10 return
items.text:
Evans (Achilles) isn't expected to be ready to play Sunday at Dallas, though the 49ers will continue to evaluate his status throughout the week, Brooke Evans of the team's official site reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.
